relation: Supplied-partition uniformity: for a supplied map part : T -> 'I_k on an arbitrary finite vertex type T and a family E : {set {set T}}, every member e of E meets each class j in exactly one vertex, #|[set v in e | part v == j]| = 1. The map and family stay supplied: no existential partition, positive rank, nonempty family, global balance, surjectivity or no-isolated-vertex condition. At rank 0 the map forces an empty carrier and every family qualifies. Members then have exactly k vertices, so the family is uniform (D1); the converse fails for a supplied map. X73 balanced fibres, graph multipartite, bipartite and edit-to-partite namesakes are separate contracts.
